changelog: Four new ways to use your memory — Clipboard capture (what you copy is saved and recallable), Commitment tracking (promises pulled from your meetings: what you owe and what's owed to you), a People view (everyone from your meetings, to-dos, and commitments), and a Timeline (what was on your screen through any day). New chat commands: 'what did I promise?', 'what do people owe me?', 'who do I know?'
